title: Auditor action observation and workflow proposals
scope: Detect repeated approved action sequences and propose versioned workflows for supervisor review

acceptance.text: Detect repeated approved action sequences and propose versioned workflows for supervisor review
No proposal auto-activates; compare suggested workflow against held-out case traces
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: No proposal auto-activates; compare suggested workflow against held-out case traces

evidence.text: ai/workflows/workflow_observation.py reads one tenant's TAX-059 audit-ledger entries (entry_view shape, optional approved-outcome detail) and builds per-case traces from approved work only (authorised evidence requests; approved decisions not followed by execution_failed); reads, denials, overrides, drafts, rejections and withdrawals never become steps and unrecognised detail is not trusted. Contiguous sequences (length 2-6) in >=3 training cases across >=2 distinct actors become maximal, versioned workflow_proposal records (proposal_id content digest, version 0.1.0, observer version, supporting ledger event IDs) for supervisor review.

tests/ai/test_action_observation.py (11 tests) on genuine sealed TAX-059 MemoryLedger chains (verify_chain intact): every proposal is status proposed, auto_activate false, approved_by null; activate() refuses with activation_not_permitted; deterministic SHA-256 split keeps held-out cases out of training support; the common 3-step sequence is compared with 4 held-out cases (coverage 3/4, followed when started 3/4, one divergence named); insufficient holdout is reported not hidden; one-actor and rare sequences not proposed; deterministic and replay-safe under duplicate/reordered delivery; tenant mismatch, chain-position conflict and malformed entries fail closed. .venv-ai pytest tests/ai: 168 passed; ruff/mypy (148 files) pass.

Tests and evidence recorded on task/TAX-064 (criteria 1-2). Branch current with main, pushed explicitly; human-review PR https://github.com/Vati-AI/rsl-taxathon/pull/154 opened with checks, limitations and Windows-only environment exceptions documented. Agent will not merge.
